MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which initial is said with a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. b
   B. m
   C. f
   D. p

2. On which letter does the tone mark go in the syllable duì? (1 mark)
   A. d
   B. i
   C. u
   D. No letter

3. In the syllable hǎo, which part is the final? (1 mark)
   A. ao
   B. h
   C. hǎ
   D. o only

4. What does 哥哥 (gēge) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Daughter
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Older brother
   D. Love

5. What is the word order of a simple location sentence in Mandarin? (1 mark)
   A. Thing + 在 + place
   B. Thing + place + 在
   C. 在 + thing + place
   D. Place + thing + 在

6. Read the pinyin: yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is on the left.
   B. The television is in the living room.
   C. The chair is under the table.
   D. There is a bed in the bedroom.

7. What does 星期五 (xīngqīwǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Mosque
   C. Seven
   D. To rest

8. Which pair of numbers is easily mixed up in sound? (1 mark)
   A. yī (1) and èr (2)
   B. sì (4) and shí (10)
   C. sān (3) and bā (8)
   D. liù (6) and qī (7)

9. Which word is pronounced wǒmen? (1 mark)
   A. 杯子
   B. 我们
   C. 来
   D. 送

10. Which sentence means "My birthday is on 5 March."? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 朋友送我礼物。
   C. 你生日是几月几号?
   D. 我的生日是三月五号。

11. What does 盘子 (pánzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Gift
   B. Plate
   C. Knife
   D. Birthday

12. Which of these is a staple food that gives the body energy? (1 mark)
   A. 茶 tea
   B. 水 water
   C. 米饭 rice
   D. 咖啡 coffee

13. What is a tongue twister used for? (1 mark)
   A. To tell time
   B. To practise clear and fluent pronunciation
   C. To count numbers
   D. To write characters

14. Which Chinese word means "water"? (1 mark)
   A. 牛肉 niúròu
   B. 水 shuǐ
   C. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   D. 喜欢 xǐhuan

15. Which body word is a single character, one you can write with 3 strokes? (1 mark)
   A. 目 mù (eye)
   B. 头 tóu (head)
   C. 耳 ěr (ear)
   D. 口 kǒu (mouth)

16. Which word means "very" in 雨很大? (1 mark)
   A. 大
   B. 雨
   C. 很
   D. 的

17. What does 前面 (qiánmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Table
   B. Door
   C. In front of
   D. Television

18. What does 浴室 (yùshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Bathroom
   C. Sofa
   D. Below

19. What does 再见 zàijiàn mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Good morning
   C. Thank you
   D. Hello

20. Which sentence means "The television is in the living room."? (1 mark)
   A. 窗户在沙发上面。
   B. 花园在房子右边。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 电视在桌子上。

21. What does 朋友 (péngyou) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Month
   B. Date (day of the month)
   C. Friend
   D. To wish

22. What is a reading journal for? (1 mark)
   A. Playing games only
   B. Keeping words and sentences you have learnt
   C. Storing food
   D. Listing chores

23. Which sentence means "For breakfast I eat bǐng."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   B. 这是香蕉。
   C. 我早饭吃饼。
   D. 我喝茶。

24. What does 笑 (xiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To look, to see
   B. To brush teeth
   C. To laugh, to smile
   D. Nose

25. What does 天气 (tiānqì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Big
   B. Also
   C. The wind blows
   D. Weather

26. Which character has an extra line on top of 大? (1 mark)
   A. 太
   B. 人
   C. 入
   D. 天

27. Which two words share the final -ang? (1 mark)
   A. 好 hǎo and 老 lǎo
   B. 门 mén and 手 shǒu
   C. 房 fáng and 旁 páng
   D. 小 xiǎo and 早 zǎo

28. Which stroke rule is used when writing 好? (1 mark)
   A. Right before left
   B. Top only
   C. Bottom first
   D. Left part 女 before right part 子

29. Which Chinese word means "to be called"? (1 mark)
   A. 谢谢 xièxie
   B. 叫 jiào
   C. 您好 nín hǎo
   D. 再见 zàijiàn

30. What does 我家有五口人 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am five years old
   B. I have five brothers
   C. There are five people in my family
   D. My house has five rooms

31. How is a sentence about a person written? (1 mark)
   A. 是这我 + 。
   B. 这是我 + family word + 。
   C. 我这是 + 。
   D. 家有 + 。

32. Which sentence means "There are five people in my family."? (1 mark)
   A. 我家有五口人。
   B. 我爱你。
   C. 那是我哥哥。
   D. 这是我姐姐。

33. Which sentence means "On Saturday I rest at home."? (1 mark)
   A. 我星期六在家休息。
   B. 星期天,去教堂。
   C. 明天是星期四。
   D. 今天星期三。

34. Which sentence means "I like to drink tea."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喜欢喝茶。
   B. 我早饭吃饼。
   C. 这是香蕉。
   D. 我喝茶。

35. What does 零食 (língshí) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Snacks
   C. Breakfast
   D. To like

36. What does 吃 (chī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Lunch
   B. To like
   C. To eat
   D. Beef

37. What does 刷牙 (shuāyá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To use
   B. Ear
   C. Foot
   D. To brush teeth

38. Which Chinese word means "below"? (1 mark)
   A. 门 mén
   B. 下面 xiàmiàn
   C. 桌子 zhuōzi
   D. 东西 dōngxi

39. What memory trick helps with 右? (1 mark)
   A. It has 女 in it
   B. It has 日 in it
   C. It has 口 (mouth) in it, and we eat with the right hand
   D. It has 工 in it

40. How many strokes do 左 and 右 each have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 3
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my mother." (2 marks)

42. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 礼物 and 冰箱. (2 marks)

43. Explain why a healthy plate should have food from several groups and name two groups with their Chinese names. (4 marks)

44. Draw the four tone marks over the vowel a and name each tone. (3 marks)

45. Write the five weather words in pinyin. (3 marks)

46. Write the difference in meaning between chuáng and chuāng. (2 marks)

47. Write the stroke names of 手 in order. (3 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very light." (2 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" (2 marks)

50. Give two words with the final -ao and one with the final -ang, with pinyin. (3 marks)

51. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 三 and 什么. (2 marks)

52. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I drink tea." (2 marks)

53. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 香蕉 and 饼. (2 marks)

54. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 妹妹 and 米饭. (2 marks)

55. Write three actions of the body and the part that does each. (3 marks)

56. Write three birthday activities in Chinese or English. (3 marks)

57. Write a paragraph of four sentences about your week in Chinese with pinyin, using the days and activities from this lesson. (5 marks)

58. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bathroom is beside the garden." (3 marks)

59. Write two strategies for speaking Chinese clearly. (3 marks)

60. Write a short conversation of three lines in which two learners greet each other, give their names and ask "And you?". Include pinyin. (5 marks)

61. Blend the syllables zhuō and zi and give the meaning. (2 marks)

62. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my father." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — p
   p has a puff of air, while b does not.

2. B — i
   With ui the mark goes on the second vowel, i.

3. A — ao
   h is the initial and ao is the final. The tone mark sits on the a.

4. C — Older brother
   哥哥 (gēge) means older brother.

5. A — Thing + 在 + place
   For example 冰箱在厨房.

6. C — The chair is under the table.
   yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. is 椅子在桌子下。, which means "The chair is under the table.".

7. A — Friday
   星期五 (xīngqīwǔ) means Friday.

8. B — sì (4) and shí (10)
   sì has an s sound and shí has an sh sound.

9. B — 我们
   我们 is pronounced wǒmen and means we.

10. D — 我的生日是三月五号。
   我的生日是三月五号。 (wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.) means "My birthday is on 5 March.".

11. B — Plate
   盘子 (pánzi) means plate.

12. C — 米饭 rice
   Staple foods such as rice give energy.

13. B — To practise clear and fluent pronunciation
   Tongue twisters practise hard sounds.

14. B — 水 shuǐ
   水 (shuǐ) means water.

15. D — 口 kǒu (mouth)
   口 has three strokes; 头 has 5, 耳 has 6 and 目 has 5.

16. C — 很
   很 hěn means very.

17. C — In front of
   前面 (qiánmiàn) means in front of.

18. B — Bathroom
   浴室 (yùshì) means bathroom.

19. A — Goodbye
   再见 means see you again, goodbye.

20. C — 电视在客厅。
   电视在客厅。 (diànshì zài kètīng.) means "The television is in the living room.".

21. C — Friend
   朋友 (péngyou) means friend.

22. B — Keeping words and sentences you have learnt
   A journal helps you review and check your progress.

23. C — 我早饭吃饼。
   我早饭吃饼。 (wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.) means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

24. C — To laugh, to smile
   笑 (xiào) means to laugh, to smile.

25. D — Weather
   天气 (tiānqì) means weather.

26. D — 天
   天 tiān is 大 with a line on top.

27. C — 房 fáng and 旁 páng
   fáng and páng both end in ang.

28. D — Left part 女 before right part 子
   Write from left to right.

29. B — 叫 jiào
   叫 (jiào) means to be called.

30. C — There are five people in my family
   五口人 is five people.

31. B — 这是我 + family word + 。
   For example 这是我爸爸。

32. A — 我家有五口人。
   我家有五口人。 (wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.) means "There are five people in my family.".

33. A — 我星期六在家休息。
   我星期六在家休息。 (wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.) means "On Saturday I rest at home.".

34. A — 我喜欢喝茶。
   我喜欢喝茶。 (wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.) means "I like to drink tea.".

35. B — Snacks
   零食 (língshí) means snacks.

36. C — To eat
   吃 (chī) means to eat.

37. D — To brush teeth
   刷牙 (shuāyá) means to brush teeth.

38. B — 下面 xiàmiàn
   下面 (xiàmiàn) means below.

39. C — It has 口 (mouth) in it, and we eat with the right hand
   Most people eat with the right hand.

40. D — 5
   Both have five strokes.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 礼物: lǐwù, gift. 冰箱: bīngxiāng, fridge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Each group does a different job. Vegetables and fruit (蔬菜, 水果) give vitamins, rice (米饭) gives energy, and meat (肉) helps the body grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 1 mark for each group named, 1 mark for the job.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: ā first tone (high, flat), á second tone (rising), ǎ third tone (dipping), à fourth tone (falling).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct marks, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four with names.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: tàiyáng, yún, fēng, yǔ, xuě.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for all five.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: chuáng 床 is a bed and chuāng 窗 is a window. The tones are different.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很小。 fēng hěn xiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 好 hǎo, 小 xiǎo; 房 fáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 三: sān, three. 什么: shénme, what.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喝茶。 wǒ hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: 香蕉: xiāngjiāo, banana. 饼: bǐng, flat bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 妹妹: mèimei, younger sister. 米饭: mǐfàn, cooked rice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 看 with the eyes, 听 with the ears, 说 with the mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: 切蛋糕 (cut the cake), 送礼物 (give gifts), 唱歌 (sing), 和朋友一起玩 (play with friends). Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一到星期五,我去学校。星期六,我在家休息。星期天,我去教堂。 xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, wǒ qù xuéxiào. xīngqīliù, wǒ zài jiā xiūxi. xīngqītiān, wǒ qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for order and punctuation. Any sensible activities.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen first and copy the tone with your hand; say it slowly then faster; record yourself and compare.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each strategy, 1 mark for explaining how it helps.

60. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好!我叫安娜。你呢? nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Ānnà. nǐ ne? A: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct greeting line and 1 mark each for the name sentences, 1 mark for correct pinyin tone marks, 5 in total.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: zhuōzi, table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.
